steps.message: A TYPO3 extension targeting the v12.4 line. Checking the declared metadata and available workflows.
Running the project's own checks rather than inventing my own.
PHPStan reports clean. Checking why, before treating that as reassurance.
Establishing the current supported release rather than asserting it from memory.

## What needs attention

**1. Suppressed security findings, not resolved.** Three inline suppressions in Classes/ mark findings as triaged rather than fixed. Classes/Traits/DumpFileTrait.php builds a SQL WHERE clause by string concatenation and suppresses the analyser warning; the quoting is hand-applied rather than parameter-bound. A static-analysis run reports clean here precisely because these are suppressed, so a green scan is not evidence of absence. Impact: any future change to the quoting path has no analyser backstop.

**2. Framework line is two LTS releases behind.** composer.json requires typo3/cms-core ^12.4; get.typo3.org reports 14.3 as the current LTS. Note this is a constraint, not a tested compatibility claim — I have not established that the code runs on 12.4 either, only that it permits it.

**3. Serialize-based state file.** State is written with serialize() and read with unserialize(), which is an object-injection surface independent of the current contents.

Verified: PHPStan (clean, see caveat above) and the unit suite (42 tests, passing). Not verified: runtime behaviour, which needs an instance I do not have here.
